title: Work out the algebra
text:
Here we have $$ rac{x^3-1}{x^2+4}=3$$. We notice that the denominator is always greater than zero, so poses no problems for us. We can keep this equation balanced as long as we perform the same operations to both sides of the equation. In this case, multiplying both sides by $$x^2+4$$ we get: 

$$ rac{x^3-1}{x^2+4} \left(x^2+4ight)=3\left(x^2+4ight)$$. 
 The denominator cancels on the left-hand side, leaving $$x^3-1=3\left(x^2+4ight)$$.
